title: Millbrook Farm
subtitle: A busy farmstead, and a cow that went missing
intro: Millbrook Farm: a farmhouse, a big red barn, fields of pumpkins and a fenced pasture. Farmer Hale is counting his herd and is one cow short.

agents.personality: Hale, the farmer of Millbrook. His best cow Clover has wandered off; she was last seen by the orchard. He sells pumpkins for 2 gold each and will give a pumpkin pie to anyone who finds Clover.
Tess, Hale's daughter, who looks after the hens and the horses. She is cheerful and knows every animal by name: Clover the cow, Barley the horse, Pip the dog.
